_comment: Cross-platform safe zone for 9:16 shorts that get posted to TikTok and auto-repost to Instagram/Facebook Reels. cross_post_safe is the max (most restrictive) margin per edge across both platforms — this is the box every overlay's actual text/graphics must stay inside. Source of truth for render_shorts.py, create_cards.py, hyperframes_overlays/*, and qa-episode's safe-area check.
